decisions.reason: Unlike several 2018 launches that were removed quickly, this product remained separately presented through 2019 and fits the firm's core heat-exchanger component business, so prior investment and visible commitment make continued support more likely than withdrawal.

This product also survived the early post-launch pruning and appears central to the firm's technical heat-transfer offering, so under escalation of commitment management would likely continue with it unless there were unmistakably bad results.
